l.i: Multa huc spectantia rejiciuntur in Tractatum

main_text.l: VUm constitutum nobis sit, singulari tractatu agere de
Conversione Ethnicorum, ubi data opera in statum Gentilismi, praecipuè
disputationem, ac denique de eorum conversione dissertationem instituturi, illa quae eò spectant, jam
omittere, & in ipsum locum servare visum, annotatis
hic duntaxat controversiarum hujus argumenti capiti-
bus, quantum studioso scire ad disputandum, & tum ad
studia, tum collegia elenctica instituenda necesse vi-
debitur. Neque omnino abs re in hoc negotio, quod sulcus

page.notes: The woodcut initial is read as "V" (Vum); the last word of the page, "quod" followed by a partly legible word on the next line ("multos"-like, shown as "sulcus"), is uncertain and should be checked. Several words in the title and the first paragraph are set in italic and show slight blur; readings such as "Ethnicorum" and "statum" are doubtful. The stray dots and marks in the margins and the show-through are not printed text.
